1.stem_plain: "I will see you __________ home later," Mother said.

2.stem_plain: During our Social Studies lesson last week, we __________ surprised when the teacher gave us a quiz.

3.stem_plain: Ali and his brother __________ overjoyed when their parents took them to their favourite restaurant.

4.stem_plain: "Keep quiet. The Primary 6 pupils __________ a test now!" said the monitor.

5.stem_plain: Last evening, I __________ to the shopping mall after I had my dinner.

6.stem_plain: While we __________ the movie, my mobile phone suddenly rang.

7.stem_plain: __________ boys over there are playing on the swing.

8.stem_plain: Muthu was scolded by his mother __________ he did not complete his homework.

9.stem_plain: We are only going on a short holiday so we will be back in __________ days.

10.stem_plain: "Can I borrow __________ money? I forgot to bring my wallet," Meiling asked Susan.

1.note: “at home” 是固定介词搭配，意为“在家”。
1.concept: 介词固定搭配 — Prepositions of Place — at home

2.zh: 在上周的社会研究课上，当老师给我们做测验时，我们感到很惊讶。
2.note: “last week”（上周）提示过去时间，主语 “we” 是复数代词，因此系动词使用复数过去式 were。
2.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

3.zh: 当父母带阿里和他的弟弟去他们最喜欢的餐厅时，他们欣喜若狂。
3.note: 从句动词 “took” 提示事情发生在过去，主语 “Ali and his brother” 为复数（两个人），因此选用复数过去式系动词 were。
3.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

4.zh: “保持安静。六年级的学生们现在正在考试呢！”班长说。
4.note: 时间词 “now!”（现在）提示动作正在进行，主语为复数名词 “pupils”，因此动词使用现在进行时 are taking。
4.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense

5.zh: 昨天傍晚，我吃过晚饭后去了购物中心。
5.note: “Last evening”（昨天傍晚）明确提示过去时间，谓语动词应选用一般过去式 went。
5.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

6.zh: 当我们正在看电影时，我的手机突然响了。
6.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句表示过去一个正在持续进行的动作，被另一个突发事件（手机响了）所中断，主语为 we，因此使用过去进行时复数形式 were watching。
6.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense

7.zh: 在那边荡秋千那些男孩正在玩耍。
7.note: “boys” 为复数名词，且由空间修饰词 “over there”（在那边）提示距离较远，因此选用远称复数的指示代词 Those。
7.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — Those

8.zh: 穆图被他母亲责备了，因为他没有完成功课。
8.note: 后半句 “he did not complete his homework”（他没做完功课）是前半句被责备的原因，因果逻辑连接词选用 because（因为）。
8.concept: 原因连词 — Conjunctions of Reason — because

9.zh: 我们只是去度个短假，所以几天后就会回来。
9.note: “days” 是可数名词复数，且前面有 “only” 以及 “short holiday”（短假）限制，表达数量很少的几天，故选用 a few。
9.concept: 修饰可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — a few

10.zh: “我能借点钱吗？我忘了带钱包，”美玲向苏珊问道。
10.note: 在期望得到肯定答复的疑问句/请求句中，表示“一些、一点”通常使用 some 而不用 any。“money” 是不可数名词，不能用 many 修饰。
10.concept: 不可数名词修饰语 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — some

11.stem_plain: The water in the pond was so __________ that I could not see the fish inside clearly.

12.stem_plain: Siti followed the __________ closely to make cheesecake. She made sure she did not miss any step.

13.stem_plain: Father bought Kumar a bicycle as a __________ for doing well in his examinations.

14.stem_plain: Jason __________ home after school as he had hurt his left knee during recess.

15.stem_plain: My father is __________ but he still donates to the poor regularly.

16.stem_plain: Boon Lee __________ a serious injury when he fell down the steps.

11.zh: 池塘里的水太浑浊了，我无法清楚地看到里面的鱼。
11.note: “cloudy” 除了表示“多云的”，常用于形容液体（如水、汤等）不透明、浑浊，符合水质不清晰的语境。
11.concept: 形容词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — cloudy

choices.zh: 有薄雾的，朦胧的（常形容空气或天气）
choices.eg: The view of the mountains was **hazy** due to the afternoon smog.

choices.zh: 多雾的，有雾气的（常形容天气或镜片）
choices.eg: It was a cold, **misty** morning when we arrived at the lake.

choices.zh: 大雾弥漫的（常形容天气）
choices.eg: Driving was dangerous because the highway was extremely **foggy**.

choices.zh: 浑浊的，不澄清的
choices.eg: Stirring up the sand at the bottom made the river water **cloudy**.

12.zh: 西蒂严格按照食谱制作芝士蛋糕。她确保自己没有漏掉任何步骤。
12.note: “recipe” 意为“食谱”，指包含具体制作步骤的烹饪指导，与后文制作蛋糕（make cheesecake）及步骤（step）完美契合。
12.concept: 名词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — recipe

choices.zh: 清单，列表
choices.eg: She made a shopping **list** of ingredients before going to the supermarket.

choices.zh: 菜单（餐厅点菜用）
choices.eg: The waiter handed us the **menu** as soon as we sat down at the table.

choices.zh: 食谱，烹饪法
choices.eg: My grandmother gave me her secret **recipe** for chocolate chip cookies.

choices.zh: 时间表，日程安排
choices.eg: The train service is running on a tight **schedule** during peak hours.

13.zh: 父亲买了一辆自行车送给库马尔，作为他考试取得好成绩的奖励。
13.note: “reward” 指因良好的表现、努力或善行而获得的“回报、奖励”（常由亲友给予），符合考试考得好获得礼物的语境。

choices.zh: 奖品（通常通过比赛或竞争获得）
choices.eg: The student won first **prize** in the national art competition.

choices.zh: 奖杯（通常为体育赛事或官方荣誉）
choices.eg: The captain proudly held the championship **trophy** above his head.

choices.zh: 奖赏，回报
choices.eg: A cash **reward** was offered to anyone who found the missing dog.

choices.zh: 纪念品
choices.eg: She bought a small key ring as a **souvenir** of her trip to Paris.

14.zh: 杰森放学后一瘸一拐地走回家，因为他在课间休息时伤到了左膝。
14.note: “limped” 意为“一瘸一拐地走”，与后文提到的膝盖受伤（hurt his left knee）有必然因果关系。
14.concept: 动词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — limped

choices.zh: 一瘸一拐地走，跛行
choices.eg: After twisting his ankle during the match, he **limped** off the field.

choices.zh: 步伐沉重地走，吃力地走
choices.eg: The exhausted soldiers **trudged** through the deep snow for hours.

choices.zh: 碎步急跑，疾走
choices.eg: The little mouse **scurried** across the floor when the light turned on.

choices.zh: 摇摇摆摆地走（常指鸭子或肥胖者）
choices.eg: The penguins **waddled** down the icy slope toward the freezing sea.

15.zh: 我的父亲很节俭，但他仍然定期向穷人捐款。
15.note: 后半句用 “but” 引导转折，表示他虽然自己平时省吃俭用（thrifty），但对别人依然很大方（donates regularly）。
15.concept: 连词转折与形容词辨析 — Contextual Clues & Adjectives — thrifty

choices.zh: 善良的（与后半句捐款在语意上顺承，不符合but的转折）
choices.eg: It was very **kind** of you to help the lady carry her heavy bags.

choices.zh: 节俭的，节约的
choices.eg: By being **thrifty** with her budget, she managed to save enough for a holiday.

choices.zh: 自私的（自私的人通常不会定期捐款，存在逻辑矛盾）
choices.eg: Don't be **selfish**; you should share your sweets with your friends.

choices.zh: 大方的，慷慨的（与donates语意顺承，不符合but的转折）
choices.eg: He made a **generous** donation to the charity to support the orphans.

16.zh: 文利从台阶上摔下来时受了重伤。
16.note: “sustained an injury” 是固定搭配，意为“遭受伤害/受伤”。
16.concept: 词汇固定搭配 — Collocations — sustained an injury

choices.zh: 忍受，忍耐（通常指长期忍受痛苦或折磨的过程）
choices.eg: The trapped miners **endured** freezing temperatures for three days.

choices.zh: 收到，接到（不与表示身体伤害的injury搭配）
choices.eg: She **received** many beautiful cards and gifts on her birthday.

choices.zh: 容忍，宽容
choices.eg: The teacher said that disruptive behavior in class would not be **tolerated**.

choices.zh: 遭受，蒙受（主要用于sustained injuries/losses）
choices.eg: The driver **sustained** minor bruises in the minor car accident.

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 指代上文提到的“麦克斯（Max）”。Max在句中作谓语动词told的主语，且是男性，故使用人称代词主格“he”（他）。

18.note: 指代前面爬树的“麦克斯（Max）”。在句中作及物动词warned的宾语，故使用人称代词宾格“him”（他）。

19.note: 指代“鸟妈妈（the mother bird）的雏鸟”。鸟妈妈是单数雌性动物（或统称动物），修饰名词复数chicks，故使用形容词性物主代词“its”（它的）。

20.note: 指代“他的朋友们（His friends）的自行车”。修饰名词复数bicycles，因为是复数概念，故使用复数形容词性物主代词“their”（他们的）。

cloze: Max, Bill and Sally were cycling at the park. Max noticed a nest in a tree. [Q17] told the others to stop. Max climbed the tree to reach the nest. His friends warned [Q18] to be careful. Suddenly, the mother bird arrived to protect [Q19] chicks. It pecked at Max’s hand and he fell. His friends got off [Q20] bicycles to help him. Fortunately, he had only sprained his leg.
zh: 麦克斯、比尔和萨莉正在公园里骑自行车。麦克斯注意到树上有一个鸟巢。他叫其他人停下来。麦克斯爬上树去够那个鸟巢。他的朋友们警告他要小心。突然，鸟妈妈飞来保护它的雏鸟。它啄了麦克斯的手，麦克斯掉了下来。他的朋友们从他们的自行车上下来去帮助他。幸运的是，他只是扭伤了腿。

cloze: Prototype editing cloze: The sun lend me a [Q46(hend)] when I am down.

46.note: 完美契合经典口语及书面语习语 lend a hand，表示在需要时“伸出援手”或“搭把手”提供帮助。

25.note: 结合上下文的过去进行时（was working），此处应用一般过去时 heard，表示“听到”有人在呼喊。

26.note: for dear life 为固定短语，意为“拼命地、竭尽全力地”，常与 hang onto 连用描述危急情况。

27.note: 前半句“试图自己爬上阳台”与后半句“失败了”构成明显的转折关系，故填入转折连词 but。

28.note: pull oneself up 为固定短语，表示“把自己拉上去/向上攀爬”，结合整篇故事的过去时态，应用 pulled。

cloze: Mr Shan, a foreign worker, was called a hero for saving a toddler recently.

On that day, he was working near a block of flats when he [Q25(heard)] some people shouting. He turned around and saw a toddler hanging onto the railing of a second-floor balcony [Q26(for)] his dear life. Two onlookers immediately tried to pull themselves up onto the balcony [Q27(but)] failed. Mr Shan then came to the rescue. He [Q28(pulled)] himself up easily and rescued the toddler. Everyone cheered for Mr Shan and called him a hero.
zh: 单先生是一名外籍劳工，最近因救了一名蹒跚学步的幼童而被称赞为英雄。
那天，他正在一座组屋附近工作，这时他听到有人在呼喊。他转过身，看到一个幼童正抓着二楼阳台的栏杆拼命坚持。两名旁观者立即试图自己爬上阳台，但失败了。单先生随后赶来救援。他轻松地把自己拉了上去，救下了幼童。大家都为单先生欢呼，并称他为英雄。

29.stem_plain: You can only go out if you finish your homework.

30.stem_plain: Sam likes playing board games. He likes watching movies more.

29.zh: 除非你完成家庭作业，否则你不能出去。
29.note: ‘Unless’ 相当于 ‘if ... not’。将原句中的肯定结果转换到主句时需要变成否定形式 ‘you cannot go out’，以确保逻辑语义保持一致。
29.answer: Unless you finish your homework, you cannot go out.

30.zh: 比起玩桌游，萨姆更喜欢看电影。
30.note: 固定搭配 ‘prefer doing A to doing B’ 意为 ‘比起做B更喜欢做A’。原句中提到更喜欢看电影（likes...more），因此 ‘watching movies’ 应当放在 ‘prefers’ 后面，而 ‘playing board games’ 放在 ‘to’ 后面。
30.answer: Sam prefers watching movies to playing board games.
